error.title: Startup did not finish
error.lead: One or more startup steps failed or never responded, so parts of the interface may be unavailable. The details below help locate the problem - please copy them and report to the developers.

diag.title: Startup diagnostics
diag.lead: This is the boot log of the current launch, used to locate a stuck interface or unresponsive features.
diag.bridge_missing: The IPC bridge injected by the host (Tauri) was never found, so no kernel command can answer. This usually means incomplete app resources or an outdated WebView. Please reinstall a complete build, and if it still fails, send this report to the developers.

general.download_history_hint: Display limit for the history section on the downloads page; affects display only, records are not deleted
general.llm_hint: Maintain the model list here: each entry holds a base URL, model name and key for AI services in the launcher to use by id; matching the base URL to a specific provider is handled by the AI module
general.llm_empty: No models yet. Click "Add model" to get started
general.llm_display_name_hint: Falls back to the model name when empty; effective names must be unique
general.llm_api_key_hint: Stored encrypted in the system keyring; the plaintext is never shown
general.llm_api_key_optional_hint: Leave empty to skip configuring a key for now
general.llm_api_key_keep_hint: Leave empty to keep the saved key unchanged
general.llm_name_conflict: Display name "{name}" already exists; change the display name or the model name

version.game_dir_hint: All installed versions live here. Leave empty to use the default directory. Compatible with LeviLauncher's install dir.
version.overridden: This process overrides the directory via the COPPER_VERSIONS_DIR environment variable; the setting above has no effect.

launch.default_version_hint: The version picked on the home page is synced here. It also decides which instance content downloads are installed into.

modules.no_available: No installable modules in the metadata.
modules.local_only_hint: This module is absent from the current metadata source; only local information is shown.
modules.metadata_unavailable_hint: The remote module list could not be fetched. Only modules installed on this machine are listed below. Enabling and disabling installed modules is unaffected.
modules.metadata_stale: Metadata may be out of date
modules.metadata_stale_hint: Using the last snapshot that passed verification ({time}).
modules.last_known_good: Fell back to the last known good snapshot.
modules.signature_not_enabled_hint: The metadata is missing a signature or failed signature verification; integrity relies on sha256 checks only. Cross-check with the official channel.
modules.schema_too_new: The metadata schema is newer than this launcher supports. Please update the launcher.

reason.yanked: This module has been yanked by its author or maintainer; new installs are not allowed.
reason.platform: This module does not support the current platform.
reason.api_version: This module targets a module API version the current kernel does not support.
reason.schema: The metadata schema version is not supported.

about.check_update_hint: Query GitHub Releases manually; failures show the exact reason
about.auto_check_hint: Silently checks once in the background after launch; failures never get in your way
about.update_channel_hint: stable receives releases only; beta also accepts prereleases
about.license_text: Copper Golem Launcher is released under the GPL-3.0 license.

badge.failed: Update check failed — click to retry

update.checking_hint: Contacting GitHub for the latest release…
update.downloading_hint: The download runs in the background — keep using the launcher.
update.ready_body: The package passed verification. Restart to apply.
update.failed_network_hint: Could not reach the update server. Check your network and retry.
update.failed_no_asset_hint: This release has no package for your platform. Download it manually from the release page.
update.failed_download_hint: The package download failed. You can retry.
update.open_page_failed: Could not open the release page

download.title: Downloads
download.concurrency_hint: Number of downloads running at the same time
download.history_clear_hint: Delete every finished download record (downloaded files are kept)
download.history_clear_body: Completed, failed and cancelled records will be deleted. Downloads in progress, installs and paused (resumable) tasks are not affected. Files already downloaded stay on disk; use an entry's shortcut button to open its folder.
download.actions_install_hint: The full package is already local; re-run the install without downloading again
download.reveal_missing: This entry has no file path to open

account.store_authorized: Store account authorized; retail packages can be downloaded
account.login_begin_hint: Complete the Microsoft authorization in the opened browser, then come back here.
account.token_expired: Your sign-in has expired, please sign in again

items.1: Copper Golem Launcher is modular: every feature is pluggable.
items.2: Download community modules from Settings - Modules.
items.3: You can switch the theme color freely.
items.4: Version isolation is on by default, so versions never interfere with each other.
items.5: Copper Golem Launcher can inject into any client.
items.6: Copper Golem supports multiple operating systems.
items.7: Copper Golem Launcher is developed by the CopperLamp organization.
items.8: You can do everything and start the game right here.
items.9: LL mods need the LL loader to work.
items.10: LL is a heavyweight mod loader.
items.11: Copper Golem Launcher is written in Rust.
items.12: lip download failed? Make sure GitHub is reachable.
items.13: Zhi is the core author of Copper Golem Launcher.
items.14: lip is the package manager for LL: it installs LL and downloads mods.
items.15: You can download all kinds of content in Copper Golem.
items.16: Want to report a problem? Try filing an issue.
items.17: Copper Golem is open source on GitHub under GPL-3.0.
items.19: The Android build of LL is in development.
items.20: Enjoying Copper Golem? A star would mean a lot.
items.21: Set a custom game directory in Settings - Version; LeviLauncher install folders are supported.
items.22: Downloads support pausing, resuming and retrying.
items.23: Allocate memory and add launch arguments in Settings - Launch.
items.24: Drag the title bar to move the window.
items.25: Each version keeps its own settings: editor mode, debug console and launch args are configured separately.
items.26: Stuck on something? Enable logs and debug output in Settings - Launch.
